dataset.description: This section details the data lifecycle for the massive parallel processing of 1,000 Pancreatic Cancer Whole-Genome Sequencing (WGS) samples. It covers the secure transfer protocols from external repositories, the 50 TB storage staging and pruning strategy on the RNCA infrastructure, and the FAIR compliance for sharing downstream aggregated analytical results.
dataset.title: Genomic Data Management for Pancreatic Cancer WGS Meta-Cohort
dataset.type: Genomic data (WGS of tumor-normal pairs from patients with pancreatic cancer).

dmp.description: This Data Management Plan (DMP) outlines the data lifecycle for the computational project detailing the origin and evolution of complex genomic rearrangements in pancreatic cancer. The purpose of this DMP is to define the protocols for securely transferring, processing, and managing sensitive human genomic data across a meta-cohort of 1,000 Pancreatic Cancer Whole-Genome Sequencing (WGS) samples utilizing the Portuguese National Advanced Computing Network (RNCA). It details the strict 'stage, process, and prune' batching strategy implemented to comply with HPC storage quotas (50 TB max), ensures strict adherence to external Data Access Committee (DAC) regulations regarding the secure deletion of raw patient files, and establishes the framework for publishing aggregated, non-identifiable analytical results in accordance with FAIR and Open Science principles.
